from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialFiling(BaseModel):
    """Financial statement extract for one company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts Receivable amount as reported")
    accounts_receivable_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The date/period end for this financial figure")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of filing, e.g., 'Form 10-Q'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    filings: list[FinancialFiling]
